property_summary: For any caller that is currently the owner and calls setOwner(newOwner), the contract's owner must equal the provided newOwner after the call; the mutant instead sets owner = tx.origin so for some caller/newOwner pairs (e.g., when the msg.sender is a contract or when tx.origin != _owner) the mutant's owner will differ.
change_summary: Replace assignment to owner with assignment to tx.origin so setOwner sets owner = tx.origin instead of the provided _owner.
